scope.sample_selection: Per member successful replies sorted by finished_at_utc and request_id, first/middle floor(n/2)/last. Exact decoded UTF-8 byte intervals and source dump hashes in samples.json.
scope.mechanical_checks: All completion-listed artifacts verified by size/SHA256. Native raw JSON decoding, complete assistant field values, request history and tool IDs/arguments/results, original loop/score terminal persistence and production completion checked; no model or scorer calls.
scope.graph: Not applicable to naive: no shared graph.

readability_findings: All selected first replies coherently analyze current NDA hypotheses and select one human_feedback call.
All selected middle replies update proposed evidence in response to feedback and issue one native call.
All selected final replies provide document hypothesis JSON; native raw field values survive into recorded history and final terminal.

Agents 2 and 3 final reasoning includes extended repetitive deliberation about evidence ambiguity; text remains semantically coherent and reaches a final answer. This is retained model behavior, not observed fragmented-character corruption.
limits: Bounded first/middle/last readability samples, not every reply's full prose. Long fields are sampled at predeclared UTF-8 byte windows.
Canonical JSON and preserved native field value equality do not prove original HTTP wire bytes or serving template token identity.
This qualifies the observed endpoint bootstrap scope; it does not prove full-run stability or scientific performance gains.
Valid wrong answers, normal missing answers, repetition and negative effects are not exclusion criteria.
